Share 🎉 Cyber Monday Alert: Experience The Venetian Resort Las Vegas at 50% Off This Cyber Monday, The Venetian Resort Las Vegas is serving up an irresistible deal — and it's the perfect time to experience its newly remodeled luxury suites. What’s the Deal? Up to 50% off all-suite accommodations at The Venetian. Booking window: now through 10 a.m. PST on Tuesday, Dec. 2, 2025 . Valid for stays from Nov. 16, 2025 through Sept. 10, 2026 . Requires a two-night minimum stay . Fully cancellable with a refund up to 72 hours before check-in . Why This Offer Is a Game-Changer The Venetian’s Grand Makeover The resort is nearing the finish line on a monumental $1.5 billion redevelopment , one of the largest in its storied history. That means when you book now you're not just getting a discounted stay — you're getting access to an entirely re-imagined Las Vegas experience: fresh design, elevated dining, immersive entertainment, and suites outfitted for modern comfort. Culinary & Entertainment Upgrades Worth the Trip As part of this transformation, the Venetian has brought in acclaimed new dining concepts — perfect for food lovers and nightlife seekers alike. Highlights include: Gjelina — the beloved Venice-Beach–rooted, produce-forward concept known for its California-style cuisine, now brought to the Strip as part of the resort’s new restaurant roster. COTE Korean Steakhouse — a Michelin-starred Korean BBQ and steakhouse, making its West Coast debut at the Venetian as part of the resort’s culinary overhaul. Via Via Food Hall — a fresh, laid-back yet trendy food hall giving travelers a variety of casual dining and quick-serve options in one place. Beyond dining, the Venetian’s reimagination includes upgraded entertainment offerings, spa and wellness amenities, and — broadly — a renewed resort vibe that feels fresh, modern, and distinctly Las Vegas. Suites That Deliver One of the biggest differentiators of the newly remodeled suites: you’ll find a complimentary personal mini-fridge. The Venetian is among the few major Strip properties offering this in their updated suites, setting them apart for comfort and practical stay amenities. Along with that, expect: Spacious, thoughtfully designed living areas — from cozy 650 sq ft King Suites to expansive 1,500 sq ft Grand King Suites (some with pool tables, sofa sleepers, dining tables, walk-in closets). Modern bathroom and living finishes — marble baths, Roman tubs or glass showers, contemporary décor with a nod to Venetian Carnival–inspired elegance. Guest-friendly tech and comforts — USB–C and USB charging, wireless charging pads (in certain room types), and a layout designed for both leisure and functionality. Access to new luxury – Because of the renovations, you’re not just saving money — you’re experiencing a newly reimagined “Venice-in–Vegas.” More than just a room – Upgraded dining, entertainment, and guest comforts make the stay part of the destination experience. title: Park Outdoor Celebrates 50th Digital Billboard with High-Visibility Upgrade Near Syracuse
summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, and Park Outdoor are celebrating Park Outdoor’s 50th digital billboard, a traditional billboard conversion serving travelers moving toward I‑81 just north of Syracuse, New York.
body_text: Park Outdoor Celebrates 50th Digital Billboard with High-Visibility Upgrade Near Syracuse Milestone underscores self-funded growth strategy and long-standing partnership with Daktronics BROOKINGS, S.D. – Nov. 25, 2025 – Daktronics (NASDAQ: DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, and Park Outdoor are celebrating Park Outdoor’s 50th digital billboard, a traditional billboard conversion serving travelers moving toward I‑81 just north of Syracuse, New York. The project advances Park Outdoor’s strategy to modernize proven locations and provide local advertisers with more flexible, timely messaging options. “Reaching our 50th digital is an important milestone for Park Outdoor,” said Rick Steele, executive vice president and chief operating officer of Park Outdoor Advertising. “We installed our first digital panel 13 years ago and have consistently added or converted locations since then. Because our projects are self‑funded, we can move quickly when the right opportunities arise, and we expect our digital growth to remain healthy.” “Technology has certainly improved over the years, but reliability remains our bottom line,” Steele added. “That’s the most important factor to us and our advertisers.” The 50th installation converts an already successful traditional billboard location into a two‑sided digital display with outstanding sightlines and heavy daily traffic. “We focus on market‑driven criteria – traffic patterns, proximity to retail and how people move through the area – then apply a disciplined approach to upgrading our best performers,” said Bill Dugan, vice president and general manager for Park Outdoor. “This site checked every box. By converting a proven board to digital and adding the second face, we’ve created a standout asset with exceptional visibility and strong revenue potential. It looks fantastic, and the team’s diligence made it possible.” Park Outdoor notes that about 90% of its advertiser base is local, small to medium‑sized businesses across a variety of categories, with an ongoing commitment to community service messaging when inventory is available. “Out of home can be a tone setter for the visual landscape of a community,” says Steele. “We want to use it as a vehicle to promote positive messaging and information.” Park Outdoor credits its VP of Leasing and Development, Stephen D. Frank, for working in cooperation with local and state stakeholders and making the conversion possible. Years of relationship‑building and thorough submittals eased earlier concerns and ultimately supported approval for the upgrade. Daktronics OOH product manager Lori Sieler says the incredible Park Outdoor team serves as a reminder of how everything from design to production to service plays a key role in customer success. “Their partnership and ongoing feedback have been invaluable in helping us refine our products and advance technology to serve operators and advertisers better,” Sieler explains. “Park Outdoor’s commitment to quality and innovation reflects the very best of what our industry can achieve, and we’re grateful for the collaboration that continues to drive both of our teams forward.” “Park Outdoor understands how to use digital OOH to lift both business outcomes and community communication,” said Joni Schmeichel, OOH strategist at Daktronics. “Celebrating their 50th digital underscores a disciplined approach to growth – thoughtful conversions, strong creative and a commitment to positive local impact.” About Park Outdoor Park Outdoor Advertising is a leading out-of-home media company serving Upstate New York. With a strong commitment to community engagement and advertiser success, Park Outdoor operates a growing network of static and digital billboards across the region. ​About Daktronics Daktronics helps its customers to impact their audiences throughout the world with large-format LED video displays, message displays, scoreboards, digital billboards, audio systems and control systems in sport, business and transportation applications. Founded in 1968 as a USA-based manufacturing company, Daktronics has grown into the world leader in audiovisual systems and implementation with offices around the globe. Discover more at www.daktronics.com . title: NeuroSense Receives FDA Clearance to Initiate Pivotal Phase 3 Trial for PrimeC in ALS
summary: /PRNewswire/ -- NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd. (Nasdaq: NRSN) ("NeuroSense"), a late-clinical stage biotechnology company developing novel treatments for severe...
body_text: CAMBRIDGE, Mass. , Nov. 24, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- NeuroSense Therapeutics Ltd. (Nasdaq: NRSN ) ("NeuroSense"), a late-clinical stage biotechnology company developing novel treatments for severe neurodegenerative diseases, today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has completed the review of the Investigational New Drug (IND) amendment application and authorized the Company to initiate the pivotal Phase 3 clinical trial for the evaluation of its lead drug candidate, PrimeC, for the treatment of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). With the FDA's clearance, NeuroSense is preparing for trial initiation and aims to have its first patient enrolled in the coming months upon securing the strategic resources needed to launch the trial. The global pivotal Phase 3 trial, PARAGON, is powered at over 95% to achieve its primary endpoint and to expand upon the results of NeuroSense's Phase 2b PARADIGM trial, which demonstrated promising clinical and biomarker outcomes and a favorable safety and tolerability profile. "This FDA clearance marks a meaningful advancement for NeuroSense and for people living with ALS. We believe this progress lays a strong foundation for additional achievements across several fronts in the near future," stated Alon Ben-Noon, Chief Executive Officer of NeuroSense. "We recognize the significant unmet need of people living with ALS and remain committed to delivering a meaningful therapy through our efforts." Based on prior successful discussions with the FDA and in line with its recent comments and recommendations, PARAGON is expected to be conducted in the U.S. and EU and include 300 people living with ALS randomized in a ratio of 2:1 (PrimeC : Placebo). The prospective, double-blind, 12-month placebo-controlled trial, has an open label extension to evaluate safety and efficacy of PrimeC. The trial will employ an adaptive design allowing for interim analyses to optimize sample size and assess early efficacy and futility boundaries. Additional details regarding the PARAGON trial design and timelines will be provided in NeuroSense's upcoming investor webinar on December 8th, 2025 and on NeuroSense's website. Registration to the webinar is available here . About ALS Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis ("ALS") is an incurable neurodegenerative disease that causes complete paralysis and death within 2-5 years from diagnosis. Every year, more than 5,000 people are diagnosed with ALS in the U.S. alone, with an annual disease burden of $1 billion. The number of people living with ALS is expected to grow by 24% by 2040 in the U.S. and EU. About PrimeC PrimeC, NeuroSense's lead drug candidate, is a novel extended-release oral formulation composed of a unique fixed-dose combination of two FDA-approved drugs: ciprofloxacin and celecoxib. PrimeC is designed to synergistically target several key mechanisms of ALS and Alzheimer's Disease (AD) that contribute to motor neuron degeneration, inflammation, iron accumulation and impaired ribonucleic acid ("RNA") regulation to potentially inhibit the progression of ALS and AD. About NeuroSense NeuroSense Therapeutics, Ltd. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing treatments for patients suffering from debilitating neurodegenerative diseases. NeuroSense believes that these diseases, which include amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease, among others, represent one of the most significant unmet medical needs of our time, with limited effective therapeutic options available for patients to date. Due to the complexity of neurodegenerative diseases and based on strong scientific research on a large panel of related biomarkers, NeuroSense's strategy is to develop combined therapies targeting multiple pathways associated with these diseases.
